newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Parent shifts assets to Guangdong Invest.
newsitem.headline: Parent shifts assets to Guangdong Invest.

text.p: Guangdong Investment Ltd has agreed to buy a 27-storey office building and a 50 percent stake in an expressway venture from its 37.88 percent controlling shareholder Guangdong Enterprise (Holdings) Ltd for a total of HK$1.3 billion.
Guangdong Investment has agreed to buy the office tower, with a total gross floor area of 183,229 sq ft at 148 Connaught Road Central for HK$1.2 billion, the company said on Monday.
It said HK$689.28 million would be paid in cash and the remaining HK$510.72 million would be settled by an issue of 96 million new shares at HK$5.32 per share.

Guangdong Investment has also agreed to buy a 50 percent stake in New World - Guangdong Highway Investments Co Ltd from its parent for HK$112 million in cash. The highway firm is 50 percent held by New World Infrastructure Ltd.

The venture has a 40 percent stake in Beijing-Zhuhai Expressway Guangzhou-Zhuhai Section Co Ltd which was formed to construct and operate the Beijing-Zhuhai Expressway Guangzhou-Zhuhai section. The expressway is a 129 km project linking Guangzhou and Zhuhai via Panyu and Zhongshan.
Shares of Guangdong Investment were up HK$0.10 to HK$5.60 at midday Monday. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
